messages.subject: CH. Karnchang | Major infrastructure, stakeholder governance and country strategy
messages.body:
Dear CH. Karnchang Leadership Team,

CH. Karnchang's role in Thailand's major infrastructure ecosystem makes the company a strong match for my experience leading regulated, stakeholder-intensive work around large capital assets.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy. I routinely manage formal submissions, official visits, regulator requests, community priorities and senior-level issue escalation.

I bring a disciplined approach to moving complex projects through institutions. My recent work also includes governance around renewable energy, battery storage and carbon-data readiness. This combination would support CH. Karnchang where project delivery, public-sector coordination and sustainability expectations intersect.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country-facing leadership. I have attached a CH. Karnchang-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
